page.overview:
What is Trapped Under Ice?

Trapped Under Ice is the fifth track Metallica's second album Ride the Lightning. It was written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, and Kirk Hammett. It is also one of the many songs that is on the game Guitar Hero: World Tour. It is on the Times Square Venue, right before "B.Y.O.B" by System Of A Down.

The song is about a person who is cryogenically frozen and knows about it. Unable to do anything except to helplessly scream and beg for help. Hence the name, Trapped Under Ice.

I don't know how to live through this Hell Woken up, I'm still locked in this shell Frozen soul, frozen down to the core Break the ice, I can't take anymore

Freezing Can't move at all Screaming Can't hear my call I am dying to live Cry out I'm trapped under ice
